name: ANYCALIB_FOCAL_PRIOR_CONTROL
why: the target is log(f_any / f_ref). Handing the probe log(f_any) lets it exploit the rig's narrow reference-focal prior and look excellent without any camera cue. Never counted as hand signal, and never mixed into a primary hand feature set.

name: HAND_FEATURE_VIEW_SHUFFLE
rule: within each outer fold, permute the feature ROWS among training views and, separately, among held-out views. Targets are never shuffled. Permutation is within-sequence where a sequence has at least 4 views in that partition, otherwise within the whole partition.

name: RANDOM_FEATURE_CONTROL
rule: deterministic Gaussian features of matched dimension, seeded per view id

name: TRAIN_TARGET_SHUFFLE
rule: shuffle training targets only; test targets stay true
